song.title: Please Dont Let Me Be Misunderstood

guitar.evidence: Hilton Valentine of The Animals (famous for the arpeggiated intro on 'House of the Rising Sun') is documented using Gretsch and Rickenbacker guitars in the British Invasion era.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown with medium confidence.

tone.summary: A tight, mid-forward signal chain utilizing a Boost for attack, an OD pedal for grit, the AC30 TB amp model, and a classic 4x12 cabinet with Room reverb to capture the urgent, dry British R&B sound of the era.
corrections: keep it more urgent than bluesy

rig.name: The Animals - Please Dont Let Me Be Misunderstood - Valeton GP-180
